purpose: Prove a fixed-grid horizontal spritesheet PNG can carry frame rectangles, durations, and pixel hashes through a Mechagotchi sidecar without losing semantic SLIP alignment.

external_anchors.used_for: PNG remains the image carrier for the horizontal spritesheet strip.
Spritesheet export is treated as image plus external frame metadata.
Spritesheet import is treated as workflow context, not as Mechagotchi schema.

limitations: Stage 0 spritesheet decoder supports a horizontal strip of equal-size frames only.
Frame pixels may vary visually; semantic grid metadata is restored from the sidecar.
Only fixed equal-size horizontal strips are covered.
Frame timing is metadata-only; no runtime animation playback is claimed.
